## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated (`make test`), lint passes (`make lint`)
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or real resumes in code, fixtures or screenshots
- [ ] Generated content still passes fact-checking (no fabricated skills/experience)
- [ ] New integrations use only permitted access (public APIs, robots.txt respected, no CAPTCHA/login bypass)
- [ ] Database changes include an Alembic migration (`alembic check` is clean)
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs/*) where behaviour changed
